name: RhinoTiger
author: hacha
tagline: Generative dark psytrance and hi-tech for the FM-1
description: RhinoTiger is a generative psytrance firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1, from dark psy to hi-tech. A kick, a rolling FM bass, percussion, a repeating line and a held atmosphere play by themselves in eight worlds, with breaks, builds and drops. You steer it with four macro knobs and a mix with mutes; the keys throw one-shot sounds into the music, and on the echo page they play sixteen effects. AUTO PLAY plays a whole set, across the worlds.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Started from fm1-base's template by Charles Vestal.
